chapter.verse: Komaumah hong kiphattawm hi leuleu ka hi uh hiam? Mite bangin note' tunga kong lah ding uh, ahihkeileh note' kiangpana lak ding, theihpihna lai kisam ka hi uh hiam?
Nomaumah pen komau' lungtang tunga kigelh, mi khempeuh in thei-in a sim ding uh, komau' theihpihna lai na hi uh hi.
Tua hi a, laitui tawh ahilo, a nungta Pasian' Kha tawh a kigelh, suangpek tung ahilo, mihing' lungtang tunga kigelh, kote' hawmkhiat Khris' laikhak na hihlam uh na kilangsak uh hi.
Khris hangin Pasian' sungah tu-a danin sunglam kimuanna ka nei uh hi.
Na khatpeuh kote' hanga piang ci-in a kingaihsun dingin a tehcing ka hikei uh a, kote' tehcinna pen Pasian' kiangpan ahi hi.
Pasian in laimal tawh ahilo, Kha tawh a kibawl thuciamna a thak khat vai ah nasem dingin kote a tehcing hong suaksak hi. A hang pen laimal in sisak a, Kha in nungtasak hi.

Tua hi a, (a kivengkiksak vangtaang ahi) Moses' maitang tunga vangtaang hangin Israel mite in ama' maitang tangtak en zolo uh hi. Suang tunga kikhuak laimalte tawh a kigelh, sihna tawh kipawl seppina nangawn, tua bang minphatna vang tawh hong tonkhawm ahihleh
Kha tawh kipawl seppina in minphatna vang neizaw tham ding hilo ahi hiam?
A hang pen mawhsak thukhenna tawh kipawl seppina ah tua zahin minphatna vang om ahihleh dikna tawh kipawl seppina pen minphatna vang tawh kidimzaw tham ding hilo ahi hiam?
A taktakin hih thu ah minphatna vang a nei khat a om ngei kimlai, a khupkhelh ding minphatna vang dang khat a om ciangin tua a masa pen in minphatna vang a nei nawnlo ahi hi.
A hang pen a kivengkiksak pen zong minphatna vang tawh hong tonkhawm ahihleh a kip tawntung pen in minphatna vang a neizaw tham ding mah ahi hi.
Hih bang lametna nam nei ka hih manun thugen ka hang mahmah uh a,
a vangtaang vengkik ahihlam Israel mite' muh ding lau-in dialpuan tawh a maitang a tuam Moses bang ka hikei uh hi.
Himah taleh amaute a lungsim uh khauh hi. Tuni dong mah thuciamna lui a sim uh ciangin tua dialpuan a omsuak ahi hi. A hang pen Khris tungtawn bekin tua dialpuan kilemkhia pan hi.
Himah hi, tuni dong mah Moses' laigelh a kisimkhiat simin amaute' lungtang tungah dialpuan baang lai hi.
Ahih hangin Topa' kiangah mi khatpeuh a kihei ciangin tua dialpuan a kilemkhia ahi hi.
Tu-in Topa pen Kha hi a, Topa' Kha a omna mun ah suahtakna om hi.

Eite khempeuh zong dialpuan kilemkhia i maitangte tawh Topa' vangtaang i en a, limlemel khat ah a kibangin vangtaang dawl khatkhit khat i mel kikhel hi. Tua vangtaang pen Kha ahi Topa' kiangpana hong pai ahi hi.
